title: Flash sale deadlock: reserve_stock() lock-order inversion causing 67% 500s
description: Flash sale traffic (1200 concurrent /reserve) triggered MySQL deadlocks at 240/min due to lock-order inversion in reserve_stock(): inventory_items and inventory_reservations acquired in non-deterministic order. 67% error rate on /v1/inventory/reserve. Hotfix d5e6f7a8 enforced deterministic lock order. Resolved within 15 minutes.

title: Add distributed lock and load test for flash sale inventory reservation path
description: Add Redis-based distributed lock for reserve_stock() to prevent lock-order deadlocks under high concurrency. Add load test (1000+ concurrent requests) to CI pipeline for inventory reservation. Review all other multi-table transactions for lock-order issues.
